title: Validation of a Human Peripheral Neuronal Model for ATP-P2X3 Mediated Inflammatory Pain Signaling in the Dental Pulp
html: Extracellular adenosine triphosphate (ATP) is a key alarmin in inflammatory responses and amplifies pain signaling through the activation of P2X3 receptors. This study aimed to validate a peripheral neuronal model, differentiated from human pulp stem cells, for the study of neuronal immunomodulation with relevance to ATP-P2X3 signaling.
